::: **Position:** Postdoctoral Researcher at Université libre de Bruxelles I am a postdoctoral fellow at the Centre d’Etude de la Vie Politique (CEVIPOL) and affiliated to the Institut d’études européennes (IEE) of the Université libre de Bruxelles. My research and teaching focus on European and international economic governance and on the transition to the green economy. I am the author of 'Legitimating Austerity: The Politics of Crisis in Southern Europe' (Bloomsbury, 2025). Crespy, Amandine, Tiago Moreira Ramalho, Vivien Schmidt. (2024). [Beyond ‘Responsibility vs. Responsiveness’: Reconfigurations of EU Economic Governance in Response to Crises](https://doi.org/10.1080/13501763.2024.2316286). *Journal of European Public Policy*, 31(4): 925--949. Crespy, Amandine, Tom Massart, Tiago Moreira Ramalho. (2024). [Embedding Past, Present and Future Crises: Time and the Political Construction of the Covid-19 Pandemic in the EU](https://doi.org/10.1080/07036337.2024.2329995). *Journal of European Integration*, 46(8): 1235--1255. Moreira Ramalho, Tiago. (2026). [The Letter and the Bond: Coalitions, Anti-Coalitions, and the Adoption of the Coronabond in the European Union](https://doi.org/10.1017/S1755773925100295). *European Political Science Review*. [A Portuguese Middle-Age Crisis?](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/a-portuguese-middle-age-crisis/). *Green European Journal*, 7 June 2024. Moreira Ramalho, Tiago. (2023). [Podemos and Syriza, the End of an Era?](https://www.greeneuropeanjournal.eu/podemos-and-syriza-the-end-of-an-era/). *Green European Journal*, 8/08/2023. Moreira Ramalho, Tiago. (2020). Moreira Ramalho, Tiago. (2018). Compétitivité. *Dictionnaire d'économie politique : Capitalisme, institutions, pouvoir*, Paris: Les Presses de Sciences Po. Moreira Ramalho, Tiago. (2016).
